notes.title: I released a new racing game!
notes.notes:
Sorry I've been absent from marketing & community for the past year or so. I've been working hard to get my latest project to a release state. And now I'm proud to present Rally 9000! 
GET IT HERE: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2024950/Rally_9000/

This game aims to add all the fun and expectations of a modern rally game while also offering a custom level builder and other fun things to do!

https://youtu.be/WGBqxY2j95E
